newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso unchanged in range trading.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso unchanged in range trading.

text.p: The Philippine peso closed unchanged on Wednesday at 26.340 pesos after reaching a day-low of 26.342 due to dollar inflows for fixed income investments, traders said.
The peso had reached a day-high of 26.338 in early trades but it was a pulled down to 26.342 by a 22.7 million-demand by an oil company.
After the oil firm's requirements were easily satisfied at 26.339 pesos, banks sold dollars again, traders said.
"The inflows just matched the demand," a dealer from a big bank said.
The Central Bank, however, had to step in to limit the peso's strength in afternoon trades. A dealer said the Central Bank purchased about $39 million at 26.34 pesos.
Market volume fell to $141.40 million from $175.0 million.
On Thursday, an oil firm will buy a smaller amount of dollars worth about $14 million which is not likely to impact on the peso, dealers said.
